description: Department of Local Government - North Central Province - The meeting for the purpose of electing the Chairman for the Walikanda Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically announces a meeting for the purpose of electing a Chairman for a local government body (Walikanda Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Government Elections Ordinance. It falls under Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it deals with electoral processes at the local government level, specifically the scheduling of an election meeting for a local authority position.
